- [USER] User inquired about which Asian community first brought Buddhism to America during the Gold Rush of 1848.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Buddhism did not really begin to spread in the United States until the mid-19th century.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] A significant number of Chinese immigrants arrived in the country to work on the transcontinental railroad and in the gold mines during the mid-19th century.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Many of these Chinese immigrants were Buddhists and brought their religion with them to the United States.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] In the late 19th and early 20th centuries, Buddhism began to be introduced to the United States by Japanese immigrants.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] American converts also introduced Buddhism to the United States after becoming interested in the religion while traveling or studying in Asia.
